construction_under_test: passive clauses with the provider in an oblique phrase (by-agent / from-PP source / with-PP instrument) while the patient sits in subject position

decision_criteria_preregistered.control_validity_gate: controls must yield pairs on >=11/12; otherwise the probe is invalid (controls failed) and no effect claim is made
decision_criteria_preregistered.effect_scale: report per-cell miss rates (3 oblique types x 2 patient types); no pooled percentage as headline without cell table
decision_criteria_preregistered.inconclusive: test misses 1-3/12: report as weak/inconclusive, no claim
decision_criteria_preregistered.no_effect: test misses 0/12: no construction effect in this probe
decision_criteria_preregistered.rule: outcome is diagnostic only (mirrors batch6_candidate_fn_diagnosis_v1 rule: characterize, do not build). No pipeline, lexicon, prompt or threshold change follows from any outcome.

gold_definition.annotator_view: sentence text only, blind to extractor output; annotate BEFORE running the extractor
gold_definition.labels: provides_gold YES / NO / UNCLEAR (UNCLEAR stays UNCLEAR); YES requires identifiable provider + recipient spans recorded per item
gold_definition.rule: frozen operational definition reused unchanged (semantically valid provides relation; explicit transfer/support assertion per batch7 gold practice)

minimal_pair_structure.control_twin: active canonical SVO paraphrase of the same relation with the same entities (provider as subject, recipient as object)
minimal_pair_structure.expectation: controls are expected to yield pairs; any test-vs-control miss gap isolates the construction (lexical content held constant)
minimal_pair_structure.test_item: passive sentence, provider in oblique, patient in subject position, gold YES

objective: determine whether NuExtract candidate generation systematically fails to produce pairs for gold-YES passive-oblique constructions, using active-voice minimal-pair controls
size: 12 minimal pairs (24 sentences): 3 oblique types x 2 patient types x 2 pairs per cell

split.fitting_split: none required: diagnostic probe, no learning, no threshold tuning
split.reporting_split: per factor cell (6 cells) plus test-vs-control split; cell table is the primary result format

with_reading_rule: with-PP items are admissible only when the construction unambiguously expresses a provider/source/transfer role. Comitative readings (together-with) are excluded. Instrument/means readings are excluded unless the instrument is the defined relation itself. If the reading is not unambiguously decidable: build no sentence for that item and mark the cell as unfulfillable instead of forcing gold-YES.
